study: Summit specification-guided vs code-only unit test generation
specification_provenance: Original user stories and Product Backlog; specific deployment clarification from project team

requirements.text: A user can register an account using an email address, username, and password.
requirements.evidence: Sprint 1 user story: sign-up with username/email/password.

requirements.text: Account passwords must be stored securely rather than as plaintext.
requirements.evidence: Product Backlog: authentication with secure password storage.

requirements.text: Registration generates an account verification code; in the current deployment, this code is displayed in the backend/Docker server logs for manual use, not delivered by an email provider.
requirements.evidence: Current user clarification about actual verification procedure; Sprint 1 user story documents verification flow.

evaluation_notes: Verification is performed using a code shown in backend/Docker logs; no email provider is used.
Do not require sending a real email in generated unit tests. Mock the console-code sender.
